use_cases.title: AI-Driven Predictive Maintenance for Subsea Assets
use_cases.description: Deploy machine learning models on real‑time sensor data from subsea equipment (OSVs, subsea assets) to predict component wear and schedule maintenance before failures occur, reducing downtime and maintenance costs.
use_cases.expected_value: Improved asset reliability, lower unplanned downtime, cost savings through optimized maintenance schedules.

use_cases.title: AI-Powered Route and Fuel Optimization for Marine Fleet
use_cases.description: Utilize AI to analyze weather, traffic, and vessel performance data to compute optimal routes and speeds, enhancing fuel efficiency and reducing emissions for the company’s modern fleet.
use_cases.expected_value: Lower fuel consumption, reduced CO2 emissions, cost savings, improved sustainability profile.

use_cases.title: AI-Enabled Sustainability Reporting Automation
use_cases.description: Implement AI to automatically gather, validate, and compile sustainability metrics from operational data, enabling timely and accurate reporting aligned with the company’s sustainability commitments.
use_cases.expected_value: Faster reporting turnaround, higher data accuracy, stronger stakeholder confidence in sustainability claims.
